title: Enttäuschend – als Geschenk leider nicht zu gebrauchen
review: Das Arganöl selbst kann ich leider nicht bewerten, da die Flasche bereits mit einem defekten bzw. beschädigten Deckel angekommen ist. Wie auf den Fotos zu sehen, schließt die Pipette nicht richtig und die Verarbeitung wirkt mangelhaft.Besonders ärgerlich ist, dass das Produkt als Geschenk gedacht war und so leider nicht verschenkt werden konnte. Bei einem Pflegeprodukt erwarte ich eine einwandfreie Verpackung und einen funktionierenden Verschluss.Schade, da das Produkt ansonsten einen hochwertigen Eindruck macht. Aufgrund des mangelhaften Zustands bei der Lieferung kann ich es jedoch nicht weiterempfehlen.

title: Defekt geliefert
review: Habe ich einmal eine neue Sorte, die auch noch günstiger war, ausprobieren wollen und schon ging es beim ersten mal schief. Die Flasche kam oben am Pipettendeckel defekt an und das dieser Defekt kann nicht an dem Paketdienst gelegen haben. Ich habe Bilder mitgeschickt, man sieht dass es schon ausgelaufen war und beim rausholen aus dem Karton gleich der Verschluss in drei Teile zerbröselt war. Sehr, sehr ärgerlich. Ich bleibe doch bei meiner alten Sorte von R&M.So etwas packt man nicht ein und selbst wenn es beim Verkäufer mal heruntergefallen ist, sollte man seine Artikel vor dem Versenden richtig prüfen, denn wie heißt es so schön, den letzten Test macht der Kunde.Da dies auch nur noch bis April 27 haltbar ist, war es wahrscheinlich zu dem Preis und sollte weg.Zurücksenden in diesem Zustand albern...

How wrong could I have been!I have used this in my hair multiple times after I shower (only using 3 drops!!), and every time after my hair feels super sticky and doesn’t absorb the oil at all! I have to re wash my hair to get it out, otherwise it’s just a greedy mess! Some comments say it is good for the skin, which I will try as this product did not work well for the hair for me and I have a whole bottle left! I will also be trying it as a hair mask instead to see if that makes a difference. Over all not happy with the product at the moment. I’m not sure if it’s even argon oil to be honest!!

title: Allergie auf Arganöl
review: Guten Tag,nach dem Auftragen Ihres Produktes  auf die Beine wurde meine Haut sofort feuerrot und juckte wie der Teufel. Ich mußte einen Arzt aufsuchen,der eine starke Allergie ferststellte. Er verordnete mir Fenestil und anschließend Clestone.Nach ca. 8 Tagen besserten sich die Beschwerden. Um mich zu vergewissern, habe ich eine kleine Partie am Bein nochmals mit dem Öl eingerieben. Innerhalb weiniger Sekunden zeigte sich wieder eine starke Rötung und Juckreiz. Somit ist für mich klar, Ihr Arganöl is der Auslöser meiner Beschwerden.Ich  bitte um Ihre Stellungnahme und evtl. Laborprüfung Ihres Produktes.Freundliche Grüße!Hans-E.Müller

title: A luxurious, organic multitasker that delivers flawless head-to-toe hydration
date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 7 June 2026
review: PraNaturals Pure Cold-Pressed Jojoba Oil 50ml — Organic Facial Oil for Face, Hair & Skin — Lightweight Moisturiser for All Skin Types — Rich in Vitamin E — Vegan & Cruelty-Free Carrier Oil for BodyThe PraNaturals Pure Cold-Pressed Jojoba Oil earns a flawless five-star rating, standing out as an absolute essential for anyone seeking a clean, high-performance, and entirely natural beauty routine. One of the first things you notice upon unboxing is the exceptional quality of the packaging. It arrives in a premium 50ml dark glass bottle, which plays a vital role in protecting the liquid inside. The dark glass actively filters out damaging UV light, preventing the oil from oxidising and ensuring the active nutrients remain incredibly potent and fresh from the first drop to the last. Paired with a precise glass dropper, it allows you to dispense the exact amount you need with zero mess or waste.To understand why this product is an absolute miracle worker, it helps to know how unique jojoba oil is compared to standard plant oils. Jojoba is not technically an oil; it is a liquid wax ester that chemically mirrors the exact molecular structure of human sebum (the natural oil your skin produces). Because your body recognises it instantly, it sinks deep into the skin effortlessly without leaving behind a heavy, greasy, or suffocating film. This makes it a phenomenal, lightweight moisturiser for all skin types. If you have dry skin, it deeply replenishes lost moisture; if you have oily or acne-prone skin, it actually tricks your skin into thinking it has produced enough oil, helping to balance sebum production and clear up your complexion.The benefits of this organic, cold-pressed formula extend beautifully across your entire beauty regimen. It is naturally rich in Vitamin E, a heavy-hitting antioxidant that protects the skin from environmental stressors, repairs damaged tissue, and smooths away fine lines. It functions flawlessly as a soothing face serum, a deeply conditioning hair mask to eliminate split ends, a hydrating body oil, or a gentle cuticle treatment. Because it is completely pure, vegan, and cruelty-free, it also serves as a perfect, non-irritating carrier oil for diluting your favourite essential oils. It brilliantly bridges simple, unadulterated nature with luxurious skincare results. For a truly pure, versatile, and premium hydration powerhouse, this bottle is an absolute triumph.Packaging integrity: Housed in a UV-protective dark glass bottle equipped with a precise glass dropper.Skin compatibility: Mirrors the skin's natural oils to deeply hydrate without clogging pores or leaving a greasy residue.Nutritional value: 100% organic, cold-pressed, and packed with antioxidant Vitamin E for skin and hair repair.Final rating: Five stars.

title: Properly packaged cold pressed jojoba oil exactly as it should be

review: This arrived in a cardboard carton with a fixed cardboard base to stop any possible breakage or leakage in transit. And, to prevent degradation from light, the glass should not be clear.This has a glass pipette with rubber suction top, integral with the screw top, perfect for precise drop measurement.Jojoba is very compatible with the skin's own oils (sebum) and is traditional used for both dry, oily and combination skin precisely because of that balance with the skin's own oils. title: Very well priced jojoba oil
date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 19 May 2026
review: I’m 53, tired, sensitive, dehydrated, and so is my skin.I’ve not used jojoba oil for ages, but it used to be one of my favourites. It is very similar to natural skin oil (or sebum), so it is particularly likely to be tolerated by we members of Team Sensitive.  It isn’t really an active, but it is useful as an occlusive over damp skin to limit evaporation, or help lock in more active ingredients.  It can also soften and help lift dead skin from scalp or body, or act as a general moisturiser.  It doesn’t really contain any moisture itself though, so you might want to consider using it with a humectant product like glycerin or a hyaluronic acid product. Alternatively, put a couple of drops to boost a moisturiser you already like.I’ve attached a photo so you can get a sense of the colour and texture.  It’s a fine, golden oil, which smells of very little.When I applied it to my face at night, I applied too much and rubbed it in harder than I should have done, so my face went a bit red, but my skin didn’t react.  On application, the oil absorbed well, looked a bit gleamy, and after two hours had fully absorbed, giving a pleasant glow and a hydrated look to the skin.  My dry skin looked generally happy and better hydrated.Really, you’re only supposed to use a couple of drops for a faceful, and personally, I prefer to use it at night rather than during the day as oil can interfere with makeup, SPF, etc.Nevertheless, I found this is a good value oil that you can use on scalp, body, and face and will cheer up most things. 50ml will last a good long time, but yes, I’d consider ordering this again when it does run out.
